name: sun
description: A clear circular sun with eight short, evenly spaced rays in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner requested a trial of longer Sun rays on2026-10-27. Each ray is3px long measured to the visible rounded ends at native24px and Regular1.70: centerline length1.30, spanning radial distance7.90..9.20, plus .85 caps at each end. Extend only the inner endpoint by.30; preserve the outer tips, disc radius5.10 (Filled5.95), stroke1.70, native X/Y100%, rotation0 and equal margins1.95. Filled rays are exact radius-.85 capsules around the same centerlines. The Sun Moon morph derives its Sun endpoint from this source automatically. This trial replaces the previously approved2.70px rays and awaits owner review;19 of20 pairs remain approved.
